# jamfplatform_pro_file_share_distribution_point (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro file share distribution point by `id` or by `name`. Provide exactly one.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account. `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Infrastructure | Distribution points | Read | `distribution-points` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Jamf Software LLC 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "jamfplatform_pro_file_share_distribution_point" "example_by_id" {
  id = "1"
}

data "jamfplatform_pro_file_share_distribution_point" "example_by_name" {
  name = "Main DP"
}

output "file_share_distribution_point_by_id" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_file_share_distribution_point.example_by_id
}

output "file_share_distribution_point_by_name" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_file_share_distribution_point.example_by_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the distribution point to look up. Provide either `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Display name of the distribution point to look up. Provide either `id` or `name`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `backup_distribution_point_id` (String) ID of the failover distribution point, or `-1` for none.
- `enable_load_balancing` (Boolean) Whether randomized load sharing with the failover is enabled.
- `file_sharing_connection_type` (String) File sharing protocol (`AFP`, `SMB`, or `NONE`).
- `https_context` (String) Context path appended to the server for HTTPS downloads.
- `https_enabled` (Boolean) Whether packages may be downloaded over HTTPS.
- `https_port` (Number) Port used for HTTPS downloads.
- `https_security_type` (String) Authentication type for HTTPS downloads (`USERNAME_PASSWORD` or `NONE`).
- `https_username` (String) Username for the HTTPS account.
- `port` (Number) Port used for file sharing.
- `principal` (Boolean) Whether this is the principal distribution point.
- `read_only_username` (String) Username for the read-only account.
- `read_write_username` (String) Username for the read/write account.
- `server_name` (String) Hostname or IP address of the distribution point server.
- `share_name` (String) Name of the file share.
- `workgroup` (String) Workgroup or domain for the file share.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
